reference_metadata.normalization: NFKD casefold; remove combining marks; accept whole ASCII a-z forms only; preserve MWT surface forms; exclude empty nodes.
reference_metadata.limit: Exact normalized duplicate sentences are removed across partitions. Near duplicates remain. Dante partitions are canticles of one work by one author.

config.initialization: frequency-ranked first start plus randomized starts
config.objective: Fixed-boundary conditional character n-gram objective: P(next symbol | previous order symbols), with add-alpha smoothing. Scores are weighted n-gram evidence, not a composite full-probability claim.
config.temperature_units: total objective bits, scaled from bits per predicted symbol
config.temperature_schedule: linear decay to zero over each restart
